listening.title: Refund for a damaged laptop charger
listening.speaker: Customer ↔ Agent
listening.transcript:
AGENT: TechFix support, Maya speaking. How can I help you?
CUSTOMER: Hi — I bought a laptop charger from your website last week and it arrived already cracked. The cable's frayed near the tip.
AGENT: I'm sorry about that. Could you share your order number so I can look it up?
CUSTOMER: Sure, it's 8-3-2-1-7-0-4.
AGENT: Thanks. I can see the order was placed six days ago. We'll send a replacement free of charge, and you don't need to return the damaged one.
CUSTOMER: That's great. How long will it take?
AGENT: Around three to five business days. You'll receive a tracking email shortly.
CUSTOMER: Perfect, that solves it.

questions.label: Question 1
questions.question: Why is the customer calling TechFix?
options: To cancel an order they no longer need
To report a charger that arrived damaged
To ask about a missing tracking number
To upgrade their laptop charger model
questions.explanation: The customer explains that the charger 'arrived already cracked' and the cable is frayed. An easy keyword to catch: 'damaged charger' rather than 'cancel' or 'upgrade'.

questions.label: Question 2
questions.question: What does the agent offer to do?
options: Issue a refund and collect the old charger
Repair the charger at the customer's home
Send a free replacement without requiring a return
Place a new order at a discounted price
questions.explanation: Maya says 'we'll send a replacement free of charge, and you don't need to return the damaged one.' That matches option C exactly.

questions.label: Question 3
questions.question: When can the customer expect the replacement?
options: Within 1–2 business days
In 3–5 business days
By the end of the week
The next calendar week
questions.explanation: The agent says the replacement will take around three to five business days.

questions.label: Question 4
questions.question: What physical problem does the customer describe besides the cracked charger casing?
options: The plug is bent out of shape
The cable is frayed near the tip
The charger becomes unusually hot
The power light will not turn on
questions.explanation: The customer specifically says the cable is frayed near the tip.

questions.label: Question 5
questions.question: How long ago was the order placed?
options: Three days ago
Six days ago
One week ago
Two weeks ago
questions.explanation: The agent checks the order and says it was placed six days ago.

questions.label: Question 6
questions.question: Which detail does the agent ask the customer to provide?
options: The laptop's serial number
The delivery address
The order number
The date the charger was first used
questions.explanation: Maya asks for the order number so she can look up the purchase.

questions.label: Question 7
questions.question: What is the customer's order number?
questions.explanation: The customer reads the number aloud as 8-3-2-1-7-0-4.

questions.label: Question 8
questions.question: What does the agent say the customer should do with the damaged charger?
options: Mail it to the repair centre
Bring it to a local shop
Return it with the replacement
Keep it; no return is needed
questions.explanation: The agent says the customer does not need to return the damaged charger.

questions.label: Question 9
questions.question: Will the customer be charged for the replacement?
options: No, it will be sent free of charge
Yes, but only for shipping
Yes, at a discounted price
The agent has not decided
questions.explanation: Maya offers a replacement free of charge.

questions.label: Question 10
questions.question: How will the customer learn that the replacement has shipped?
options: By a phone call
Through a tracking email
By a text from the courier
By checking the store in person
questions.explanation: The agent says a tracking email will arrive shortly.

questions.label: Question 11
questions.question: Which best describes the agent's response to the complaint?
options: She denies that the item was damaged
She asks the customer to contact the courier
She apologizes and arranges a replacement
She offers store credit instead of help
questions.explanation: Maya apologizes, verifies the order, and arranges a free replacement.

questions.label: Question 12
questions.question: What can be inferred about the customer's purchase?
options: It was made through TechFix's website
It was bought from a neighbour
It was purchased in a repair shop
It was included with a new laptop
questions.explanation: The customer says the charger was bought from the company's website.

questions.label: Question 13
questions.question: Which action is the agent taking before offering a solution?
options: Checking the order record
Calling the delivery driver
Testing the charger's voltage
Submitting an insurance claim
questions.explanation: Maya asks for the order number and looks up the order in the system.

questions.label: Question 14
questions.question: What is the most likely next step for the customer?
options: Purchase another charger immediately
Wait for the tracking email and replacement
Send the charger back for inspection
Visit TechFix to collect a refund
questions.explanation: The replacement is being sent, and the customer will receive tracking information by email.

questions.label: Question 15
questions.question: How does the customer react to the proposed solution?
options: They reject it and ask for a refund
They are pleased that the issue is solved
They ask to speak with a manager
They request a different model
questions.explanation: The customer responds 'That's great' and says the solution solves the problem.

reading.title: Apartment notice — laundry room hours
reading.passage:
To all residents of Glencove Apartments,

Starting Monday, October 3, the laundry room on the ground floor will operate on reduced hours. Machines will run from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., seven days a week, instead of the current 24-hour schedule. This change is required to complete a plumbing upgrade requested by the building's insurer.

The two dryers on the far wall will be out of service during the first week while they are replaced with quieter models. To reserve a machine, please place a laundry basket on top of it — baskets left for longer than 45 minutes will be removed to a cart by the door.

If you have questions about the new schedule, email the building office before October 2. Please do not contact the maintenance contractors directly.

Management reserves the right to extend the reduced hours if construction is delayed.

questions.label: Question 1
questions.question: Why is the laundry room schedule changing?
options: The building office is hiring new staff
A plumbing upgrade was required by the insurer
Residents complained about noise at night
The machines are being permanently removed
questions.explanation: The notice states the reduced hours 'are required to complete a plumbing upgrade requested by the building's insurer.'

questions.label: Question 2
questions.question: What might happen if a laundry basket is left on a machine too long?
options: It will be placed in a cart by the door
The owner must pay a storage fee
The items will be thrown away
It will be moved to the office
questions.explanation: The notice explains that 'baskets left for longer than 45 minutes will be removed to a cart by the door.'

questions.label: Question 3
questions.question: How should residents ask questions about the change?
options: Call the maintenance contractors directly
Speak to the plumber on site
Email the building office before October 2
Wait until the machines reopen
questions.explanation: Residents are told to 'email the building office before October 2' and explicitly not to contact the contractors.

questions.label: Question 4
questions.question: Where is the laundry room located?
options: On the ground floor
In the basement
On the roof
Beside the west parking lot
questions.explanation: The notice identifies the laundry room as being on the ground floor.

questions.label: Question 5
questions.question: What will the new daily operating hours be?
options: 6 a.m. to 8 p.m.
7 a.m. to 10 p.m.
8 a.m. to 9 p.m.
9 a.m. to 9 p.m.
questions.explanation: Machines will run from 8:00 a.m. until 9:00 p.m.

questions.label: Question 6
questions.question: How often will the laundry room operate under the new schedule?
options: Monday through Friday
Six days a week
Seven days a week
Only on weekdays
questions.explanation: The notice says the new hours apply seven days a week.

questions.label: Question 7
questions.question: What prompted the reduction in operating hours?
options: A plumbing upgrade requested by the insurer
A shortage of laundry-room staff
A replacement of every washing machine
A request from the maintenance contractors
questions.explanation: The reduced schedule is needed for a plumbing upgrade requested by the building's insurer.

questions.label: Question 8
questions.question: Which dryers will be unavailable during the first week?
options: The two nearest the entrance
The two on the far wall
All dryers on the ground floor
Only the newest dryer
questions.explanation: The two dryers on the far wall will be out of service while they are replaced.

questions.label: Question 9
questions.question: Why are the two dryers being replaced?
options: They use too much water
They are being replaced with quieter models
They cannot be reserved
They are being moved to another floor
questions.explanation: Management says the dryers are being replaced with quieter models.

questions.label: Question 10
questions.question: How should a resident reserve a machine?
options: Leave a laundry basket on top of it
Write their name on the door
Email the building office
Ask a contractor to hold it
questions.explanation: Residents reserve a machine by placing a laundry basket on top of it.

questions.label: Question 11
questions.question: What happens to a basket left for longer than 45 minutes?
options: It is taken to a cart by the door
It is placed in the building office
It is discarded immediately
It is moved to another machine
questions.explanation: Baskets left over 45 minutes are removed to a cart by the door.

questions.label: Question 12
questions.question: By when should residents email the building office with questions?
options: Before October 2
By October 3
Before the first week ends
By the end of November
questions.explanation: Residents are asked to email the office before October 2.

questions.label: Question 13
questions.question: Whom are residents specifically asked not to contact?
options: The building office
Other residents
The maintenance contractors
The insurer
questions.explanation: The notice explicitly says not to contact the maintenance contractors directly.

questions.label: Question 14
questions.question: What could management do if construction is delayed?
options: Close the entire building
Extend the reduced hours
Cancel the dryer replacement
Move laundry service off-site
questions.explanation: Management reserves the right to keep the reduced schedule longer if construction is delayed.

questions.label: Question 15
questions.question: Which statement about the schedule change is accurate?
options: The room will remain open around the clock
The new hours are the same every day of the week
The laundry room will close permanently
Only the dryers will operate after 9 p.m.
questions.explanation: The notice gives the same 8 a.m.–9 p.m. operating window seven days a week.
